name: Iran
summary: Western Asian country in the Iranian Plateau bounded by the Alborz and Zagros mountains. Tehran basin experiences severe winter inversion trapping while central deserts face dust storms.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 7.96x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); thermal inversions trap vehicular and refinery pollution in Tehran bowl.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Lake Urmia desiccation and acute water stress across central provinces.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across the arid Iranian Plateau over trailing 30-year window.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.9% share of global fossil emissions; heavy natural gas consumption for domestic heating and electricity.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: High per capita consumption driven by substantial domestic fossil fuel price subsidies.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Ancient Hyrcanian deciduous forests along Caspian coastal strip covering ~107,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Dominated by Zagros mountain hydroelectric dams (6.8%); wind and solar deployment expanding slowly.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 55 people/km²; urban population fraction is 76.8%.
